contract: A typed cache multiplication entry point borrows only a closed right polynomial under its read guard and returns an owned product. Cache miss returns the identical owned left input; cache-hit decline remains distinct and marks reuse. Preserve original Box payloads and owned normalizer results.
lock_review: Inspected product insertion and coefficient operations use Rational arithmetic and immutable structural comparison. The closed right payload has no Computable fields; rational fields and tracing do not call EvaluationCache or user callbacks. The parent expression retains the right node while its cache is borrowed. The guard must be released before recursive normalization, publication or returning the product. This is scoped source inspection, not a whole-crate formal proof.
risks: A product holds a read lock longer than a shallow clone; arbitrary coefficient bit sizes mean no constant wall-time bound or wait-free writer claim.
Additional helper dispatch, Result moves and code generation can regress non-hit paths or increase binaries.
Concurrent publication after a miss remains allowed; no second root cache probe is added.
Opaque left atoms retain original ownership and structural comparisons; they must never be evaluated in the borrowed kernel.
invariants: Left normalization precedes the right lookup.
A retained cache hit still bypasses the depth/work counters, including zero depth/work.
A miss enters the exact original body once with original sharing, memo and work accounting.
A cached product decline marks reuse and preserves the mandatory original retry after dropping the first memo.
No new cache field, shared owner, public API, dependency, approximation or looser bound.
P4 permits Unknown to become Certified but forbids contradictory or weaker available facts.
Both original full-resolution 120-second board worker-CPU and 60-second neck check-body-wall gates remain.
